title: TMP Camera Surveillance Next 2.20.84
summary: Optionaler ausgehender HTTPS-Kameraproxy mit persistenter Installations-ID und privatem, separat bereitgestelltem PHP-Portal.
changes: Generate persistent per-installation UUID in the SQLite settings store
Add optional outbound HTTPS polling agent with strict camera-read allowlist
Manage one-time pairing and relay status through admin-only system endpoints
Keep the private PHP server entirely outside GitHub
Allow optional HTTP_BIND_ADDRESS=127.0.0.1 to close WAN/LAN cleartext web access
name: TMP Camera Surveillance Next v2.20.84
description: Optional outbound-only secure camera relay and pairing with a separately deployed private PHP portal.
releaseNotes: 2.20.84 adds persistent installation UUID, opt-in HTTPS polling relay, individual encrypted agent key, 10-minute pairing code and admin controls. Private portal PHP code is distributed separately and never stored in the camera GitHub repository. Local camera streaming and recording paths remain unchanged.
